reason: A DSH web interface plugin that provides a collapsible, searchable conversation outline sidebar with navigation between chat and trajectory positions; Full mode may load the entire conversation history and affect performance.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 网页对话界面提供可折叠、可搜索的侧边栏大纲，按轮次列出消息并支持跳转到对话或轨迹中的对应位置。
summaries.en: Adds a collapsible, searchable sidebar outline to the DSH web chat for browsing conversation turns and jumping to matching positions in the chat or trajectory view.

capabilities: Reads loaded conversation messages to build an outline
Optionally loads and parses the full conversation history
Adds a persistent collapsible sidebar to the chat interface
Filters outline entries by keyword and navigates to corresponding chat or trajectory positions
